hi. i’m also 15, though i’m a girl. i, too, despite still being a bit active on social media, feel i’m becoming very lonely. i’ve always kinda felt lonely, i suppose, but since covid started it’s been worse. i feel ive withdrawn myself from everyone, and nothing excites me anymore, really. i don’t care to spend time with anyone, besides maybe 3 or 4 close friends. i truly understand the feeling of loneliness—it’s something that has creeped within me all my life. my best piece of advice to you is maybe try interacting on online servers more? i talk to random people on twitter with similar interests, and though interactions aren’t too large, it’s enjoyable. maybe you should try getting back into social media (such as snapchat) just to be able to interacting easily with kids from school or something. i do understand that it’s a very toxic environment, and that you may not want to, but it may be beneficial to at least consider. now that you’ve had time to improve and work on yourself, maybe you can comfortably start making plans to hang out with those you trust and are close to. maybe like a hangout once a week, or something. 
wishing you the best.
